variants.headline: Party names a new leader
variants.body: The party {party} has a new leader: {new}. Labour finds the stewardship of {target} wanting; ordinary people deserve a more responsible standard of conduct.

variants.headline: Leadership changes hands
variants.body: Leadership of {party} has changed, with {new} the new leader. Labour finds the stewardship of {target} wanting; ordinary people deserve a more responsible standard of conduct.

variants.headline: A new name at the head of the party
variants.body: The new leader of {party} is {new}. Labour finds the stewardship of {target} wanting; ordinary people deserve a more responsible standard of conduct.
